A1.justification: Both complete 13-page PDFs describe LATTE-MV and include supplementary Appendices A–D. Full-text comparison and rendered-page checks support reliable comparison of the text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction measurements, conformal coverage evaluations, and simulated robot performance in Sections 3.5 and 5, with additional experiments in Appendix D.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the simulated return rates in Table 3 and the sensitivity experiments in Appendix D.

M1.justification: The reconstruction pipeline, transformer architecture and objective, conformal prediction procedure, and anticipatory controller are unchanged, including the controller details in Appendices A–C.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same reconstructed table-tennis dataset of 73,222 exchanges and the same prediction and simulated robot-control tasks. No datasets or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: The non-anticipatory baseline and oracle pre-positioning comparator remain unchanged in Table 3 and the corresponding Appendix D comparisons in Tables 5–7.

E3.justification: The five training subsets, 2,500-exchange calibration set, 1,000-exchange test set, simulation settings, evaluation metrics, and appendix experimental settings are identical.

E4.justification: Both retain the confidence-width and extreme-hit analyses, plus Appendix D experiments varying the central pose, shrinkage parameter lambda, and anticipation time Th. No analyses are added or revised.

E5.justification: Ensemble spread estimates, conformal intervals, and empirical coverage reporting are unchanged. There are no changes to repeated-run or seed disclosures, uncertainty reporting practices, or statistical tests.

E6.justification: All reported results are unchanged. Table 3 retains return rates of 49.9% for Baseline, 59.0% for Anticipatory, and 64.5% for Oracle; the appendix results and plotted findings are also identical.

T1.justification: The camera assumptions, trajectory equations, conformal coverage guarantee and union-bound reasoning, controller definitions, and appendix equations are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: scalable monocular reconstruction and uncertainty-aware anticipation that improves simulated ball returns from 49.9% to 59.0%.

C2.justification: Interpretations and qualifications are identical, including missing winning segments, population bias, reconstruction constraints, controller limitations, and the need for physical-hardware validation.

D1.justification: Architecture specifications, training budgets, GPU information, simulation and PPO implementation details, and the project website disclosure are unchanged. The added funding acknowledgement provides no new reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Section 2, the novelty positioning, and all 46 cited works remain unchanged. References move within pages 9–10 without any bibliographic additions or removals.

P1.justification: v2 adds Section 7, Acknowledgements, containing a paragraph identifying two funding awards, and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The research narrative and supplementary text are unchanged.

P2.justification: The acknowledgement shifts the reference layout across pages 9–10, and the version stamp changes. All figures, tables, and supplementary page layouts remain identical.

improvement.justification: v2 adds funding attribution and updates the version stamp, with minor reference reflow. The methods, empirical evidence, theory, limitations, and appendices are unchanged. These administrative and presentation changes do not meaningfully alter the paper's overall quality.
